breaking.change: The creation form film is removed: forms are 2d, 2.5d and 3d, the world's. An interactive film is genre "interactive-film" in the form its live scenes and levels draw in, its flow run by project.ogt's flow line. og check and the cook refuse form "film", naming the fix.
breaking.fix: Write form "3d" (og upgrade rewrites it) and keep genre "interactive-film". To let the engine start and draw the flow, add flow "story/<name>.yarn" to project.ogt and delete the game's own og.story.load, og.flow.load, og.flow.start and its picture, Subtitles and FlowChoices mounts; read the flow with og.flow.current(world).

breaking.change: A form no longer decides which creation fields apply: formFields and GAME_ONLY are gone, CREATION_FIELDS lists the create block's fields, and the creation document's compat.formFields is compat.fields. Every genre but interactive-film names a view; an interactive film may leave it out. The creation document has no film form (byForm, looks' forms).
breaking.fix: Read CREATION_FIELDS (compat.fields) instead of formFields(form) (compat.formFields[form]), and treat view as optional for genre interactive-film.

added.summary: flow "story/<name>.yarn" makes that dialogue the game's flow: the engine loads, prepares and starts it before GameDesc.start, the cook counts its segments, footage and scenes among the bundle's first modules, and the built-in FlowScreen draws it (a flow { screen game } block leaves drawing to the game).
The flow project.ogt's flow line started: what a playable segment passes to og.flow.advance, and what a title screen pauses and plays.

Built-in screens (@origingame/engine/ui/components): FlowScreen draws a flow's picture with its dissolve, its captions and its choice window; FlowPicture is the picture alone, with a Skip button for a cutscene.

The keyframe kind asks for an image-to-video model's first frame at the project's aspect (BriefOptions.aspect, 16:9 by default); medium sets a prop's or character's medium, image or model, over the profile's.
